name: Surya Saputra
bio: Surya Saputra is an Indonesian actor, singer, and producer. He started acting at the age of 6 in the film Sejuta Serat Sutra (1981). Surya won several awards in acting, notably the Best Supporting Actor award in FFI 2004 for his role in the film Arisan! (2003).
